papers.title: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: 本文通过接触片段训练和自身成功轨迹重训，为策略塑造宽且明确的交接边界，并逐步向任务前期扩展。RoboTwin 2.0随机场景成功率98.4%，比最强基线高26.4个百分点；API成本降41.3%，耗时降37.5%。
papers.summary_en: This paper shapes wide and explicit handoff boundaries for the policy through contact-segment training and retraining on its own successful trajectories, and progressively extends them toward earlier stages of the task. On RoboTwin 2.0 randomized scenes, the success rate is 98.4%, 26.4 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline; API cost is reduced by 41.3%, and time consumption is reduced by 37.5%.

papers.title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
papers.summary: HOG-WAM 在 FastWAM 这类"世界-动作模型"上，训练时额外加一个只在训练中使用的 HOG DiT 分支，让它通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征、去预测**未来帧的方向梯度直方图（HOG）**。这个确定性的结构监督会反向塑造控制所用的 RGB 表征；推理时整个分支直接删除，架构和参数量都不变。效果上，抗噪声这一项提升最明显：RoboTwin 混合噪声下 78.86%→82.86%，LIBERO Plus 传感器噪声下 74.14%→78.89%。真机 Franka 上的增益更大，平均成功率无噪 40%→59%、有噪 17%→24%。
papers.summary_en: HOG-WAM builds on "world-action models" such as FastWAM by adding, during training, an extra HOG DiT branch used only in training, which reads RGB features via asymmetric attention to predict the **histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) of future frames**. This deterministic structural supervision in turn shapes the RGB representation used for control; at inference the entire branch is removed outright, leaving the architecture and parameter count unchanged. In terms of results, the improvement is most pronounced in noise robustness: 78.86%->82.86% under RoboTwin mixed noise, and 74.14%->78.89% under LIBERO Plus sensor noise. The gains are larger on a real Franka robot, where average success rate rises from 40%->59% without noise and from 17%->24% with noise.

papers.title: SOLVE: Sparse, Ordered Keyposes Make LLM Agents Versatile and Efficient Robot Manipulator
papers.summary: **作者先发现人类遥操作数据大多可以压缩成少量直线连接的末端关键位姿，据此提出了免训练的智能体策略 SOLVE：多模态 LLM 每次调用写出一串（不超过 5 个）绝对 6-DoF 末端关键位姿，交给运动规划器执行，再用"稀疏像素 3D 查询"给这些位姿定位，用"合并后冻结的经验规则"做自我改进。结果在 RoboDojo（74.5%）、RoboLab（84.5%）和 RoboTwin 2.0（94.8%）上都超过了所有榜单方法，真机零样本 16 个任务的成功率是 88%，每个 episode 平均只要 1.7 美元，比逐步控制的 LLM 智能体便宜 12 倍。**
papers.summary_en: **The authors first find that most human teleoperation data can be compressed into a small number of end-effector keyposes connected by straight lines, and based on this propose SOLVE, a training-free agentic policy: in each call, a multimodal LLM writes out a sequence of (no more than 5) absolute 6-DoF end-effector keyposes, which are handed to a motion planner for execution; it then uses "sparse pixel 3D queries" to ground these poses, and "merged-then-frozen experience rules" for self-improvement. As a result, it surpasses all leaderboard methods on RoboDojo (74.5%), RoboLab (84.5%), and RoboTwin 2.0 (94.8%); on a real robot, its zero-shot success rate across 16 tasks is 88%, and each episode costs only $1.7 on average, 12 times cheaper than step-by-step-control LLM agents.**

papers.title: RoboEvo^2: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
papers.summary: **RoboEvo² 以当前 VLA 策略的失败为驱动，构建了一个循环。一边是"代码智能体 harness"：它沿三条并行路线（纯代码 / 代码+示范 / 代码+调用策略）修复每次失败，再把修复沉淀成技能、记忆和路由。另一边是神经策略：它通过 SFT 和"同起点成功/失败对比"的反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD），把这些修复内化成自己的能力。两者交替进化。在不增加人类示范的情况下，LIBERO-PRO 上独立策略成功率从 11.0% 提升到 84.1%（混合执行 30.4%→90.5%），同时每轮 API 花费从 $430 降到 $99。**
papers.summary_en: **RoboEvo² builds a loop driven by the failures of the current VLA policy. On one side is a "coding-agent harness": it repairs each failure along three parallel routes (pure code / code + demonstrations / code + policy calls), then distills the repairs into skills, memory, and routing. On the other side is the neural policy: through SFT and counterfactual preference distillation (CPD) based on "same-start success/failure contrasts," it internalizes these repairs as its own capabilities. The two evolve in alternation. Without adding human demonstrations, the standalone policy success rate on LIBERO-PRO rises from 11.0% to 84.1% (hybrid execution 30.4%->90.5%), while the API cost per round drops from $430 to $99.**

papers.title: DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering
papers.summary: **DemoFoundry 把“动作”和“外观”拆开生成：编码智能体（GPT-6 Astra）根据一张场景参考图重建几何、写控制程序，在物理仿真里跑出带精确动作标签的“代理（proxy）视频”；再用一个在 1,884 对“真实–仿真对齐视频”上微调的视频模型，把代理视频渲染成照片级观测。这样不需要目标任务的人类示教就能造出训练数据：只用 50 条合成数据训练的策略接近 50 条真机数据的效果（π0.5 均值成功率 60.0% vs 62.2%），与真机数据混合后提升到 82.2%。**
papers.summary_en: **DemoFoundry generates "motion" and "appearance" separately: a coding agent (GPT-6 Astra) reconstructs geometry from a single scene reference image and writes a control program, running it in physics simulation to produce "proxy videos" with precise action labels; then a video model fine-tuned on 1,884 pairs of "real-simulation aligned videos" renders the proxy videos into photorealistic observations. This makes it possible to create training data without human demonstrations for the target task: a policy trained on only 50 synthetic demonstrations approaches the performance of one trained on 50 real-robot demonstrations (π0.5 mean success rate 60.0% vs 62.2%), and mixing them with real-robot data raises it to 82.2%.**

papers.title: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
papers.summary: AIRIS 是一个第一人称因果流式视频基准。它把"社交具身智能"拆成一条按时间锚定的链：注意（Attention）→意图（Intention）→反应（Reaction）→交互评估（Interaction），共 8,000 道题。在 45 个模型上的测试显示，现有 VLM 擅长"看懂"社交线索，但不会"等证据够了再下判断"：判断条件还不满足时，有 26%–51% 的查询会抢先猜一个意图；也没法把"要不要介入、用什么方式、具体怎么做"一起做对，联合准确率不超过 14.7%。
papers.summary_en: AIRIS is an egocentric, causal, streaming video benchmark. It breaks "social embodied intelligence" down into a time-anchored chain: Attention -> Intention -> Reaction -> Interaction evaluation, with 8,000 questions in total. Tests on 45 models show that existing VLMs are good at "understanding" social cues but do not "wait until there is enough evidence before making a judgment": when the conditions for a judgment are not yet met, 26%-51% of queries preemptively guess an intention. They also cannot jointly get right "whether to intervene, in what manner, and how exactly to do it," with joint accuracy no higher than 14.7%.

papers.title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
papers.summary: 现有动作条件机器人世界模型在抓取失败（物体被推、倾倒、滑落）时，预测的物体运动几乎不比"复制首帧"的静态基线好。作者用仿真扰动抓取，生成了 62k 条带物理真值的失败与成功轨迹（Reforge 数据集），并在训练时加了两个零推理开销的辅助损失：交互区域重建（IA）和表面点跨帧对应（SC）。在 Cosmos3 Nano 上，物体轨迹误差降低 28.2%，未见物体上降低 35.0%，配对动作的结果差异误差降低 43.3%，在真实视频上也有小幅迁移收益。
papers.summary_en: When grasps fail (objects get pushed, tipped over, or slip), existing action-conditioned robot world models predict object motion barely better than a static baseline that "copies the first frame." The authors perturb grasps in simulation to generate 62k failure and success trajectories with physical ground truth (the Reforge dataset), and add two auxiliary losses with zero inference overhead during training: interaction-area reconstruction (IA) and cross-frame surface-point correspondence (SC). On Cosmos3 Nano, object trajectory error is reduced by 28.2%, by 35.0% on unseen objects, and the outcome-difference error for paired actions is reduced by 43.3%; there is also a small transfer benefit on real videos.

papers.title: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
papers.summary: iMFPO用区间条件共享actor统一瞬时速度回归与一步生成，结合iMF残差比率的在线RL和PPO教师蒸馏，在四种机器人上1步持平64步RFPO，Go2延迟15.57降至0.41ms，但对一步基线增益小。
papers.summary_en: iMFPO uses an interval-conditioned shared actor to unify instantaneous velocity regression and one-step generation, combined with online RL based on the iMF residual ratio and PPO teacher distillation. On four robots, 1 step matches 64-step RFPO, and Go2 latency drops from 15.57 to 0.41 ms, but the gain over one-step baselines is small.

papers.title: SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: SEEK 让基于通用多模态大模型的机器人智能体在模型参数不变的前提下跨次尝试积累"执行知识"：一个持久的"动作-效果证据库"（PAEB）记下每个动作在什么条件下产生了什么效果，失败的也记；一个可自我修订的程序化策略（SEPP）把操作写成按当前观测决定动作的可执行代码。代码能覆盖的场景就不调用模型，覆盖不了时由模型依据证据改代码。在 RoboDojo 42 个任务上，平均分从 27.0 提到 54.4；换成 GPT-6.2 Astra 后，在 34 个任务上从 49.6 提到 80.1，模型请求少了 77.6%。
papers.summary_en: SEEK lets a robot agent based on a general-purpose multimodal large model accumulate "execution knowledge" across attempts while keeping the model parameters unchanged: a persistent "action-effect evidence base" (PAEB) records what effect each action produced under what conditions, including failed ones; a self-revisable programmatic policy (SEPP) writes the manipulation as executable code that decides actions based on the current observation. For scenarios the code can cover, the model is not called; when the code cannot cover them, the model revises the code based on the evidence. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, the average score rises from 27.0 to 54.4; after switching to GPT-6.2 Astra, it rises from 49.6 to 80.1 on 34 tasks, with 77.6% fewer model requests.

papers.title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
papers.summary: DexEngine 的做法是：先在物理仿真之前替每个人类手–物示范片段找好“手臂够得到的场景摆放位置”和一条连续的手臂 IK 轨迹，再用一个在腕部空间输出残差、随机起点时把手臂重置回该参考轨迹的残差强化学习策略批量做物理修正。它从 9 个人类数据集生成了 4 种灵巧手 × 双臂 RB-Y1 的物理可执行数据，共 6.5 万条轨迹（116 h）、32.5 万个 episode（578 h）。用这些数据训练的策略远好于用纯运动学回放数据训练的，用它做 mid-training 在仿真和真机上都进一步提升了效果。
papers.summary_en: DexEngine's approach is: before physics simulation, find for each human hand-object demonstration segment a "scene placement reachable by the arm" and a continuous arm IK trajectory, then use a residual reinforcement learning policy, which outputs residuals in wrist space and resets the arm back to this reference trajectory at random starting points, to perform physical correction in batches. From 9 human datasets, it generates physically executable data for 4 dexterous hands x the dual-arm RB-Y1, totaling 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h). Policies trained on this data are far better than those trained on purely kinematic replay data, and using it for mid-training further improves performance both in simulation and on real robots.

papers.title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
papers.summary: PyRUA-Dex 不用任何演示数据，让 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的编码智能体在仿真里先由 8 个智能体并行探索、蒸馏出一个分阶段的 Python 程序，再按“阶段成功率”定位最薄弱的阶段、在大量随机布局上逐个修复。最终得到的是一份测试时不调用大模型的冻结程序策略。它在 Bench2Dex 上拿到 72.9 分，是新的 SOTA；在 DexJoCo 全随机化设置下成功率 81.0%，两个基准上都超过所有用演示训练的策略。在双 22 自由度灵巧手的真机上，它能弹钢琴、写毛笔字，学一首新曲子最快约 30 分钟。
papers.summary_en: PyRUA-Dex uses no demonstration data at all. A coding agent driven by GPT-6 Astra works in simulation: first, 8 agents explore in parallel and distill a staged Python program; then, using "per-stage success rate," it locates the weakest stage and repairs the stages one by one over a large number of randomized layouts. The final result is a frozen programmatic policy that does not call a large model at test time. It scores 72.9 on Bench2Dex, a new SOTA, and reaches an 81.0% success rate under the fully randomized setting of DexJoCo, outperforming all demonstration-trained policies on both benchmarks. On a real robot with two 22-degree-of-freedom dexterous hands, it can play the piano and write calligraphy with a brush, and it can learn a new piece of music in as little as about 30 minutes.

papers.title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
papers.summary: ROAM-Bench 在 Isaac Sim 里搭了 27 个室内场景、250 个人工校验过的主动探索任务，用仿真器真值**分开判定**两件事：答案（或最终场景状态）对不对（A），以及该看的东西有没有看到、该做的交互有没有做（N）。只有两者都满足才算严格成功（T = A AND N）。结果是最强的 VLM（GPT-6-astra）T 为 69.2%，人类为 84%。论文还发现两类互补的失败：一类是“答对了但没完成要求的探索”，另一类是“证据都看到了却仍然判断错”。
papers.summary_en: ROAM-Bench builds 27 indoor scenes and 250 manually verified active-exploration tasks in Isaac Sim, and uses simulator ground truth to **judge two things separately**: whether the answer (or final scene state) is correct (A), and whether the things that should have been seen were seen and the interactions that should have been performed were performed (N). Only when both are satisfied does it count as strict success (T = A AND N). The result is that the strongest VLM (GPT-6-astra) achieves a T of 69.2%, versus 84% for humans. The paper also finds two complementary types of failure: one is "answering correctly but without completing the required exploration," and the other is "seeing all the evidence yet still judging incorrectly."

papers.title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: SimPWM 只用首帧和动作序列，先在一个无训练参数的规则点云模拟器里"演算"出机械臂和被抓物体怎么动，再让视频模型把这个模拟画面渲染成逼真视频，同时把模拟出的状态一起输出。借此作者第一次能用冻结物体、夹爪不闭合这类扰动去检验"视频到底有没有照着代理（proxy）画"。结论是：三种视频基座都会跟随渲染出的机械臂；但物体状态只有 MiniMax-H3 这类先验偏向参考视频的基座才跟，LTX-2.3 主要靠手臂动作自己"脑补"抓取。
papers.summary_en: Using only the first frame and the action sequence, SimPWM first "computes" how the robot arm and the grasped object move in a rule-based point-cloud simulator with no trainable parameters, then has a video model render this simulated imagery into a realistic video, while also outputting the simulated states. This allows the authors, for the first time, to use perturbations such as freezing the object or keeping the gripper from closing to test "whether the video actually follows what the proxy depicts." The conclusion is: all three video backbones follow the rendered robot arm; but object states are followed only by backbones such as MiniMax-H3 whose priors lean toward the reference video, while LTX-2.3 mainly relies on the arm motion to "imagine" the grasp on its own.

papers.title: OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution
papers.summary: **OmniPersist 在同一个视频扩散模型里同时生成普通透视视频和一条低帧率的 360° 全景视频，用 GeoAnch（同一时刻按几何对应交换特征）和 TemComp（跨相邻时刻聚合特征）把两路连起来。镜头转开时，画面外的行人、车辆仍在全景画布上继续运动，镜头转回来就不会“变脸”或消失。基于 Wan2.2-5B，在 CameraCtrl 和 UCPE 两种相机控制方式上，这一设计在 14 项指标上全面优于各自的基线。**
papers.summary_en: **OmniPersist generates both an ordinary perspective video and a low-frame-rate 360° panoramic video within the same video diffusion model, linking the two streams with GeoAnch (exchanging features at the same moment according to geometric correspondence) and TemComp (aggregating features across adjacent moments). When the camera turns away, off-screen pedestrians and vehicles keep moving on the panoramic canvas, so when the camera turns back they do not "change appearance" or disappear. Based on Wan2.2-5B, under both camera-control approaches, CameraCtrl and UCPE, this design comprehensively outperforms the respective baselines across 14 metrics.**

papers.title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
papers.summary: **GOLD-SLAM 在 FAST-LIVO2 式误差状态滤波前端和 Gaussian-LIC2 式高斯后端的基础上，把整套跟踪和建图统一到球面（ERP）投影下。它做了三件事：在全景图里没有 LiDAR 覆盖的"盲区"用视觉方位约束补充位姿估计；用 LiDAR 实测深度加全景单目深度（DAP）初始化高斯；用深度感知的插入/剪枝（DAEP）修补增量建图中新表面被遮挡、出现漂浮物的问题。最终在 4 个公开数据集和自采的无人机数据集 WHOLE 上，深度误差全面最低，渲染质量大多领先；定位精度与 FAST-LIVO2 基本持平，在走廊、弱几何、高动态场景中漂移更小。**
papers.summary_en: **Building on a FAST-LIVO2-style error-state filtering front end and a Gaussian-LIC2-style Gaussian back end, GOLD-SLAM unifies the entire tracking and mapping pipeline under spherical (ERP) projection. It does three things: in the "blind zones" of the panorama without LiDAR coverage, it uses visual bearing constraints to supplement pose estimation; it initializes Gaussians using LiDAR-measured depth plus panoramic monocular depth (DAP); and it uses depth-aware insertion/pruning (DAEP) to fix the problems of newly appearing surfaces being occluded and floaters appearing during incremental mapping. Ultimately, on 4 public datasets and the self-collected drone dataset WHOLE, its depth error is the lowest across the board and its rendering quality leads in most cases; its localization accuracy is roughly on par with FAST-LIVO2, with smaller drift in corridor, weak-geometry, and highly dynamic scenes.**

papers.title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
papers.summary: CARE-3D 在 SFT 之后用 GRPO 训练一个会调用 3D grounding 工具的问答智能体。它加了两处改动：一是 **CARE**，把返回证据遮掉，看真实答案的似然下降多少，以此作为证据奖励；二是 **GCS**，每组 rollout 额外补上两条用最少用工具的 rollout，保证工具都被探索到。结果模型更会“挑对证据、按证据作答”。以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为骨干时，MSQA Overall 从 SFT 的 58.1 提到 65.7，Beacon3D Case/Obj. 从 59.6/21.2 提到 64.5/25.7。
papers.summary_en: CARE-3D uses GRPO after SFT to train a question-answering agent that calls 3D grounding tools. It adds two modifications: first, **CARE**, which masks out the returned evidence and measures how much the likelihood of the ground-truth answer drops, using this as the evidence reward; second, **GCS**, which supplements each group of rollouts with two additional rollouts using the least-used tools, ensuring that all tools get explored. As a result, the model becomes better at "picking the right evidence and answering based on the evidence." With Qwen3-VL-4B as the backbone, MSQA Overall rises from 58.1 under SFT to 65.7, and Beacon3D Case/Obj. rises from 59.6/21.2 to 64.5/25.7.

papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
papers.summary: **Entangle 用"视频到视频"生成把已有的机器人录像批量改成人手版本，得到逐帧时间对齐的人-机配对数据。在此基础上训练一个世界-动作模型（WAM），把人类演示视频和机器人观测沿时间轴拼接，并加入"同任务内对比"的 InfoNCE 损失。这样机器人在不更新参数的情况下只看一段人类视频，就能执行训练中没见过的任务：RoboTwin 7 个未见任务成功率 69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高 22.6 个点；Astribot S1 真机 6 个未见任务平均 83.5/100。模型对换布局、换工具（比如用香蕉当扫帚）也表现出一定的迁移能力。**
papers.summary_en: **Entangle uses "video-to-video" generation to convert existing robot recordings into human-hand versions in bulk, producing human-robot paired data aligned frame by frame in time. On this basis, it trains a world-action model (WAM) that concatenates human demonstration videos and robot observations along the time axis, and adds an "intra-task contrastive" InfoNCE loss. As a result, without any parameter updates, the robot can execute tasks never seen during training just by watching a single human video: on 7 unseen RoboTwin tasks it achieves a 69.5% success rate, 22.6 points higher than Zero-WAM; on 6 unseen tasks on the real Astribot S1 robot it averages 83.5/100. The model also shows a certain degree of transfer ability to changed layouts and changed tools (for example, using a banana as a broom).**

papers.title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
papers.summary: RoboDojo-Mirror只给场景加镜子，5种机器人操作策略成功率全部下降，平均降10.8–56.7个百分点；哑光面板对照显示多数失败与碰撞无关，而是把倒影当目标或定位错真实物体，真机亦然。
papers.summary_en: RoboDojo-Mirror only adds a mirror to the scene, yet the success rates of all 5 robot manipulation policies drop, with average decreases of 10.8-56.7 percentage points; a matte-panel control shows that most failures are unrelated to collisions and instead come from treating the reflection as the target or mislocalizing the real object, and the same holds on real robots.

papers.title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
papers.summary: ICLWorld 用 30 个自建环境、630 段自录演示和 160 个“反直觉规则”任务（每个任务有 3 个规则版本），在统一的 GUI 接口 UIverse 下考察同一批前沿智能体在电脑和机器人上的上下文学习能力。结果是：最强模型在电脑任务上能做到约 80% 的成功率，在机器人任务上只有约 27%。模型几乎都能答对规则是什么，却经常执行不出来，所以瓶颈在执行，不在理解。
papers.summary_en: ICLWorld uses 30 self-built environments, 630 self-recorded demonstrations, and 160 "counterintuitive rule" tasks (each task has 3 rule versions) to examine, under a unified GUI interface called UIverse, the in-context learning abilities of the same set of frontier agents on computers and on robots. The results show that the strongest model achieves about 80% success on computer tasks but only about 27% on robot tasks. The models can almost always correctly state what the rule is, yet often fail to carry it out, so the bottleneck lies in execution, not in understanding.

papers.title: ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: ReFocus 把长程操作任务拆成子任务 DAG，按"每个阶段分得同样多奖励"的规则给进度奖励；再让 LLM 调度器根据进度记录找出策略反复卡住的阶段，从仿真快照恢复到该阶段附近集中练习（Local RL），并与全任务训练（Global RL）交替进行。这样，在 π0.5 上 LIBERO-Long 成功率从 90.6% 提到 97.8%，RoboCasa365 从 39.3% 提到 51.3%；真机 BreadBaker 任务从 30% 提到 95%。
papers.summary_en: ReFocus decomposes long-horizon manipulation tasks into a DAG of subtasks and assigns progress rewards under the rule that "each stage receives an equal share of the reward"; it then has an LLM scheduler use the progress records to identify the stages where the policy repeatedly gets stuck, restores from simulation snapshots to near those stages for focused practice (Local RL), and alternates this with full-task training (Global RL). In this way, on π0.5, the LIBERO-Long success rate rises from 90.6% to 97.8% and RoboCasa365 rises from 39.3% to 51.3%; on a real robot, the BreadBaker task rises from 30% to 95%.

papers.title: LookAnything: A Foundation Model for Holistic Gaze Following
papers.summary: **作者先把 8 个分散的视线数据集统一转成 31.1 万条问答，构成 9 类视线任务的 HoliGaze 语料与评测集；再在 Qwen3-VL-2B 中加入三组可学习的"视线先验查询"，训练时分别用场景深度、头部掩码、目标热力图做辅助监督。这样一个 2B 模型不再需要头部裁剪图或深度图这类外部输入，就能以点、框、热力图或文字回答"谁在看什么"这一类问题：在自建评测上大幅领先 33 个零样本 VLM，在 5 个传统 gaze-following 基准上的平均 L2 也优于专用模型。**
papers.summary_en: **The authors first unify 8 scattered gaze datasets into 311,000 question-answer pairs, forming the HoliGaze corpus and evaluation set covering 9 types of gaze tasks; they then add three groups of learnable "gaze prior queries" to Qwen3-VL-2B, which during training are given auxiliary supervision from scene depth, head masks, and target heatmaps, respectively. As a result, a 2B model no longer needs external inputs such as head crops or depth maps, and can answer "who is looking at what" questions with points, boxes, heatmaps, or text: on the self-built evaluation it leads 33 zero-shot VLMs by a large margin, and on 5 traditional gaze-following benchmarks its average L2 is also better than that of specialized models.**

papers.title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
papers.summary: 作者在仿真中按医院设计规范生成病房，答案从 3D 场景直接算出，做成了 Clinical3D-Bench（3,368 题）和训练集 Clinical3D-45K。在这上面测了 35 个 MLLM，零样本模型几乎只比"背答案分布"的基线强一点，在"患者的左右"这类问题上普遍会把左右镜像反过来。另外发现，把 3D 当作输入喂给模型，模型基本不用。作者因此提出 GeoJeV：由 MLLM 用自己的隐状态选择 3D 计算原语，把算出来的证据直接加到每个选项的得分上，拿到了最高准确率（75.7%，医生 79.0%）。
papers.summary_en: The authors generate hospital wards in simulation according to hospital design guidelines, compute the answers directly from the 3D scenes, and build Clinical3D-Bench (3,368 questions) and a training set, Clinical3D-45K. Evaluating 35 MLLMs on it, they find that zero-shot models are only slightly better than a baseline that "memorizes the answer distribution," and on questions such as "the patient's left and right" they commonly mirror-reverse left and right. They also find that when 3D is fed to the model as input, the model basically does not use it. The authors therefore propose GeoJeV: the MLLM uses its own hidden states to select 3D computation primitives, and the computed evidence is added directly to each option's score, achieving the highest accuracy (75.7%, versus 79.0% for physicians).

papers.title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
papers.summary: **ACAP 让一台机器人由多个常驻的编码智能体共同控制：每个“成员”智能体负责一个控制组（如一条臂加夹爪，或躯干加底盘），各自异步地观察、推理、写代码并执行；一个“超级智能体”（hyper-agent，也是 lead）负责分派任务、安排依赖，并在需要紧密协作时收回控制权、自己同时操纵多条臂。在 72 次真机 rollout、25 个任务/平台设置上，ACAP 比单智能体 Direct 的任务平均耗时低 28.2%。在协作类任务上，它也明显好于“控制权永久下放给成员”的 Fixed Delegation。**
papers.summary_en: **ACAP has a single robot controlled jointly by multiple persistent coding agents: each "member" agent is responsible for one control group (such as one arm plus its gripper, or the torso plus the base), and each one asynchronously observes, reasons, writes code, and executes it; a "hyper-agent" (also the lead) assigns tasks, arranges dependencies, and, when tight coordination is needed, takes back control and operates multiple arms simultaneously itself. Across 72 real-robot rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces average task completion time by 28.2% compared with the single-agent Direct baseline. On collaborative tasks, it is also clearly better than Fixed Delegation, in which control is permanently handed over to the members.**

papers.title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: F² 在 World Action Model（ImageWAM）里加了一组和图像 patch 一一对应的“空间变化查询” Z_Δ。训练时用冻结的 VGGT 提取当前帧和未来帧的 3D 特征，两者在光流对齐后的逐 patch 差值作为监督目标；推理时只靠当前观测、指令和本体状态预测 Z_Δ，再交给动作专家生成动作。这样做多花约 4% 的推理时间，换来 RoboTwin 2.0 Full 平均 95.01%（SOTA）、LIBERO-Plus 84.5%、真机六任务平均 85.8%。
papers.summary_en: F² adds to a World Action Model (ImageWAM) a set of "spatial change queries" Z_Δ that correspond one-to-one with image patches. During training, a frozen VGGT extracts 3D features from the current frame and a future frame, and their per-patch difference after optical-flow alignment serves as the supervision target; during inference, Z_Δ is predicted from only the current observation, the instruction, and the proprioceptive state, and is then passed to the action expert to generate actions. This costs about 4% more inference time and in return yields an average of 95.01% on RoboTwin 2.0 Full (SOTA), 84.5% on LIBERO-Plus, and an average of 85.8% across six real-robot tasks.

papers.title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
papers.summary: **LeadVLA 不让 VLA 直接输出整条轨迹，而是把给定路线作为不可学习的固定 Path 参考，只学两样东西：一个标量 Pace（沿路线走多快、要不要停）和一组局部 Residual（编队修正和避让）；再加上基于 Unreal Engine 的约 400 万样本合成数据（LeadInfra）和 108 个回合的闭环基准（LeadBench）。在机器人策略中，它的综合任务成功率最高（39.6%），也能零微调迁移到 Unitree G1 真机，但离人类水平（约 86%）还差得很远。**
papers.summary_en: **Rather than having a VLA directly output an entire trajectory, LeadVLA takes the given route as a fixed, non-learnable Path reference and learns only two things: a scalar Pace (how fast to move along the route and whether to stop) and a set of local Residuals (formation corrections and avoidance); it also adds roughly 4 million samples of synthetic data based on Unreal Engine (LeadInfra) and a closed-loop benchmark of 108 episodes (LeadBench). Among robot policies, it achieves the highest overall task success rate (39.6%) and can also transfer zero-shot, without fine-tuning, to a real Unitree G1 robot, but it still falls far short of human-level performance (about 86%).**

papers.title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
papers.summary: S-Mind 在多模态大模型的序列里插入一小组"空间 token"。训练时用 3D 几何监督这些 token，让它们先把多张视图融合成同一坐标系下的 3D 场景；推理中每声明一个新视角，模型就重新输出这组 token，并被监督成"同一场景在该视角下的样子"。这样多视图融合和视角变换两种能力被内化进 Qwen3.5 骨干，4B/9B 模型在四个空间基准上平均达到 72.83%/74.03%，与 GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-5.5 这类前沿通用模型相当。推理时不调用任何外部工具，比工具型 agent 快约 100 倍。
papers.summary_en: S-Mind inserts a small set of "spatial tokens" into the sequence of a multimodal large model. During training, these tokens are supervised with 3D geometry so that they first fuse multiple views into a 3D scene in a single shared coordinate frame; during inference, each time a new viewpoint is declared, the model re-outputs this set of tokens, which is supervised to represent "what the same scene looks like from that viewpoint." In this way, the two capabilities of multi-view fusion and viewpoint transformation are internalized into the Qwen3.5 backbone, and the 4B/9B models reach averages of 72.83%/74.03% across four spatial benchmarks, comparable to frontier general-purpose models such as GPT-6-Astra and Claude-Opus-5.5. No external tools are called during inference, making it about 100 times faster than tool-based agents.

papers.title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
papers.summary: 这篇论文把机器人世界模型拆成两步：先用学到的 3D 点动力学模型（PointWorld）算出场景点在机器人动作下怎么动（“模拟”），再把这些点渲染成像素对齐的代理视频，交给视频扩散模型生成真实画面（“渲染”）。在 DROID 上，相比只把机器人渲染进画面的条件，物体运动误差降低了 8.6%（Wan2.2）和 6.2%（Ctrl-World），真实双臂机器人上降低 8.1%，画质不受影响；而且生成的视频会跟着模拟结果走，模拟越准视频越准，编辑点轨迹就能改变视频内容。
papers.summary_en: This paper splits a robot world model into two steps: first, a learned 3D point dynamics model (PointWorld) computes how scene points move under robot actions ("simulation"); then these points are rendered into pixel-aligned proxy videos and handed to a video diffusion model to generate realistic frames ("rendering"). On DROID, compared with conditioning that only renders the robot into the frame, object motion error is reduced by 8.6% (Wan2.2) and 6.2% (Ctrl-World), and by 8.1% on a real dual-arm robot, with image quality unaffected; moreover, the generated videos follow the simulation results, so the more accurate the simulation, the more accurate the video, and editing point trajectories can change the video content.

papers.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
papers.summary: LoopedWAM 让世界动作模型（WAM）的视频专家和动作专家都"存 12 块、循环跑 30 层"，把策略参数压到 0.58B（峰值显存是 Fast-WAM 的 1/7.4），精度与约 6B 的 Fast-WAM 相当；再用"弹性自蒸馏"训练出单个 checkpoint，部署时可以自选动作循环次数 K_a 和采样步数 N，在 24.7–86.2 ms 之间换速度，LIBERO 成功率只在 95.2%–96.2% 之间变动。
papers.summary_en: LoopedWAM has both the video expert and the action expert of a world action model (WAM) "store 12 blocks and loop them to run 30 layers," compressing the policy parameters to 0.58B (peak GPU memory is 1/7.4 that of Fast-WAM) while matching the accuracy of the roughly 6B Fast-WAM; it then uses "elastic self-distillation" to train a single checkpoint that, at deployment, allows freely choosing the number of action loops K_a and the number of sampling steps N, trading off speed between 24.7 and 86.2 ms, while the LIBERO success rate varies only between 95.2% and 96.2%.

papers.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
papers.summary: 作者让 GPT-6-Astra 这类前沿多模态大模型直接当机器人策略，对 harness（提示、规划、动作执行、工具使用）做逐因素的受控消融，总结出一套配方：xhigh 推理、640×360 双视角图像、绝对 EEF 坐标、固定 8 步 chunk、短多动作序列工具，再加上让大模型修正 VLA 给出的动作。这套配方在 RoboLab-120 上拿到 83.3% 成功率，比最强基线高 26.2 个百分点。作者进一步论证，大模型的操作能力主要来自**空间目标估计**，而不是生成底层关节或轨迹动作的能力。
papers.summary_en: The authors have frontier multimodal large models such as GPT-6-Astra act directly as robot policies, and run controlled, factor-by-factor ablations of the harness (prompting, planning, action execution, tool use). From this they distill a recipe: xhigh reasoning, 640x360 dual-view images, absolute EEF coordinates, fixed 8-step chunks, a short multi-action-sequence tool, plus having the large model correct the actions proposed by a VLA. This recipe reaches an 83.3% success rate on RoboLab-120, 26.2 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. The authors further argue that the large model's manipulation ability comes mainly from **spatial target estimation**, rather than from the ability to generate low-level joint or trajectory actions.

papers.title: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: WeaveVLA 是一个可外挂到现有 VLA 上的插件模块。它围绕任务相关物体、夹爪 TCP 和邻近参照物建一张**稀疏 3D 关系图**，给每条“实体对”边配一个 **GRU 记忆**，随观测不断更新，再用 Q-Former 把整张图压缩成 16 个关系 token 交给动作专家。装在 StarVLA-GR00T 和 π0.5 两个骨干上都有提升：LIBERO 平均成功率超过 98%，LIBERO-Plus 零样本鲁棒性测试从 74.9% 提到 82.0%（StarVLA-GR00T 骨干），真机 OOD 平均成功率从 33.3% 提到 53.3%。
papers.summary_en: WeaveVLA is a plug-in module that can be attached to existing VLAs. It builds a **sparse 3D relational graph** around task-relevant objects, the gripper TCP, and nearby reference objects, assigns a **GRU memory** to each "entity-pair" edge that is continuously updated with observations, and then uses a Q-Former to compress the entire graph into 16 relation tokens passed to the action expert. It yields improvements on both the StarVLA-GR00T and π0.5 backbones: the average LIBERO success rate exceeds 98%, the LIBERO-Plus zero-shot robustness test rises from 74.9% to 82.0% (StarVLA-GR00T backbone), and the real-robot OOD average success rate rises from 33.3% to 53.3%.

papers.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.summary: **同一个模型、同一个任务，只把"机器人使用接口"（RUI，即智能体能下达什么动作、这些动作怎么组织执行）换掉，Claude Code 的成功率就能在 45%–81% 之间变化，幅度远大于两个前沿模型之间的差距。论文据此提出：好的 RUI 应当"省掉不必要的决策，保留必要的反馈"；同时指出智能体普遍存在"验证缺口"——明明失败了也宣布完成。**
papers.summary_en: **With the same model and the same task, merely swapping the "robot-use interface" (RUI, i.e., what actions the agent can issue and how those actions are organized and executed) makes Claude Code's success rate vary between 45% and 81%, a range far larger than the gap between two frontier models. Based on this, the paper proposes that a good RUI should "eliminate unnecessary decisions while preserving necessary feedback"; it also points out that agents commonly exhibit a "verification gap": declaring completion even when they have clearly failed.**

papers.title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
papers.summary: ReWeave 不更新任何策略权重。它让外层 LLM 智能体从交互中归纳出一张**可修订的物理任务拓扑**（里程碑、前置条件、证据、代码），每次修订后都把历史试验按新拓扑重新评分，用结果指导 harness（上下文 C / 工作流 W / 控制环 L）的搜索，并把各专家任务中验证过的"因果单元"按未满足的前置条件检索、合并成一个紧凑的共享 harness。最终 LIBERO-PRO 成功率从 89.00% 提到 98.75%，RoboDojo 从 25.50% 提到 58.25%，未见任务迁移从 41.3% 提到 51.3%，持续学习后达到 75.0%。
papers.summary_en: ReWeave does not update any policy weights. It has an outer LLM agent induce from interaction a **revisable physical task topology** (milestones, preconditions, evidence, code); after each revision, all historical trials are re-scored under the new topology, and the results guide the search over the harness (context C / workflow W / control loop L); the "causal units" verified in each expert task are retrieved according to unmet preconditions and merged into a compact shared harness. Ultimately, the LIBERO-PRO success rate rises from 89.00% to 98.75%, RoboDojo from 25.50% to 58.25%, and transfer to unseen tasks from 41.3% to 51.3%, reaching 75.0% after continual learning.

papers.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
papers.summary: WorldLeague 用 60 个仿真机器人任务、按 6 个能力维度给 VLM、VLA、WAM 三类系统统一打分：分数只看机器人轨迹有没有真正达成物理目标。结果最强的 Claude Fable 5.2 也只拿到 28.58/100 的 Interactive Score，完成 13/60 个任务；VLM 把终局问答全部答对的 episode 里，有 71.8% 的物理操作得分为 0。也就是说，"看懂、答对"和"真正做成"之间差得很远。
papers.summary_en: WorldLeague uses 60 simulated robot tasks to score three classes of systems, VLMs, VLAs, and WAMs, uniformly along 6 capability dimensions: the score only considers whether the robot's trajectory actually achieves the physical goal. Even the strongest system, Claude Fable 5.2, obtains only 28.58/100 on the Interactive Score, completing 13/60 tasks; among episodes in which a VLM answered all the final-state questions correctly, 71.8% received a physical manipulation score of 0. In other words, there is a wide gap between "understanding and answering correctly" and "actually getting it done".

papers.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
papers.summary: GlanceNav用混合MLLM恒定大小流式记忆让每帧只编码一次、每步104毫秒，并借记忆快照做反事实回退强化学习；无外部数据的4B模型在R2R-CE/RxR-CE达71.9%/73.6%成功率。
papers.summary_en: GlanceNav uses a constant-size streaming memory in a hybrid MLLM so that each frame is encoded only once, at 104 milliseconds per step, and leverages memory snapshots for counterfactual-rewind reinforcement learning; its 4B model, trained without external data, achieves success rates of 71.9%/73.6% on R2R-CE/RxR-CE.

papers.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
papers.summary: 论文把一个预训练视频扩散世界模型（Kairos 3.1，4B）**同时**当作逆动力学模型（IDM）和前向动力学模型（FDM）来用，只额外加入可学习的“动力学寄存器”，再用“首帧相同、只有运动不同”的反事实时间对来训练，从视频里提炼出紧凑的**原生潜在动作**（32 个 128 维 token）。在此基础上提出 **PAWlicy**：以冻结的 Native LAM 作为动力学教师，在大规模人类/机器人/仿真视频上预训练 VLA，训练和推理阶段都不生成视频。最终在 LARY 上超过所有已有 LAM；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均 93.6%，为表中最高；真机两项任务也优于 π0.5。
papers.summary_en: The paper uses a pretrained video diffusion world model (Kairos 3.1, 4B) **simultaneously** as an inverse dynamics model (IDM) and a forward dynamics model (FDM), adding only learnable "dynamics registers", and trains with counterfactual temporal pairs that "share the same first frame and differ only in motion" to distill compact **native latent actions** (32 tokens of 128 dimensions) from video. Building on this, it proposes **PAWlicy**: using the frozen Native LAM as a dynamics teacher, it pretrains a VLA on large-scale human/robot/simulation videos, without generating video during either training or inference. It ultimately surpasses all existing LAMs on LARY; on RoboTwin 2.0 it averages 93.6%, the highest in the table; and on two real-robot tasks it also outperforms π0.5.

papers.title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: HIVE-Bench 固定一个 GR00T 风格的 flow-matching DiT 动作头，让它直接读取 20 个预训练视觉编码器（7 个家族）在机器人自身相机下的**全部 patch token**，在 24 个第一视角双臂任务上做闭环评测。结论有三条：保留 patch token、微调编码器、增加示教数据都能稳定提升成功率；ImageNet、分割、深度、对应点等通用视觉分数基本预测不了控制性能；逆动力学（IDM）探针是训练策略前最有用的廉价指标之一，但它也不够稳定，代替不了真机或仿真 rollout。
papers.summary_en: HIVE-Bench fixes a GR00T-style flow-matching DiT action head and has it directly read **all patch tokens** from 20 pretrained visual encoders (7 families) under the robot's own cameras, performing closed-loop evaluation on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks. There are three conclusions: retaining patch tokens, fine-tuning the encoder, and adding more demonstration data all consistently improve success rates; general vision scores such as ImageNet, segmentation, depth, and correspondence largely fail to predict control performance; the inverse dynamics (IDM) probe is one of the most useful cheap indicators before training a policy, but it is also not stable enough to replace real-robot or simulation rollouts.

papers.title: SWEEP-Bench: Do Embodied Policies Act on the Speed They See?
papers.summary: SWEEP-Bench 在 80 个传送带操作任务上，把每个任务放到 13 档带速下测试。结果发现：主流 VLA 大多不看实际速度，只学到演示数据的"平均速度时机"，所以成功率在中速最高、两头下降（倒 U 形）；加入过去帧只对少数经过多帧预训练、内部能读出速度的模型（Fast-WAM、Cosmos Policy、DynamicVLA）有用；直接给策略一个用光流估计出来的带速，能拿回真值速度带来的大部分提升。
papers.summary_en: SWEEP-Bench tests each of 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks at 13 belt-speed levels. The findings: most mainstream VLAs do not look at the actual speed and only learn the "average-speed timing" of the demonstration data, so their success rate peaks at medium speed and drops at both ends (an inverted U shape); adding past frames helps only a few models that were pretrained on multiple frames and from which speed can be read out internally (Fast-WAM, Cosmos Policy, DynamicVLA); directly giving the policy a belt speed estimated from optical flow recovers most of the gain obtained from the ground-truth speed.

papers.title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.summary: **ViDiHand2 不再让视频扩散模型直接回归手的深度，而是让它预测像素对齐的 2D 关节和 MANO 手型，再沿测试相机的射线、按 MANO 的公制骨长解一个整段视频的几何优化来求深度。这样换到没见过的相机时也能保持精度：野外绝对关节误差比最强基线低 42%（56.55→32.59 mm），速度 57 FPS。**
papers.summary_en: **ViDiHand2 no longer has the video diffusion model directly regress hand depth; instead, it has it predict pixel-aligned 2D joints and the MANO hand shape, and then solves for depth via a whole-video geometric optimization along the test camera's rays using MANO's metric bone lengths. This preserves accuracy when switching to unseen cameras: in-the-wild absolute joint error is 42% lower than the strongest baseline (56.55 -> 32.59 mm), at 57 FPS.**

papers.title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.summary: 作者先把未来场景拆成"没变的 / 变了的 / 没见过的"三类空间，发现纯相机的占用世界模型主要输在第一类：已经看到、而且没变的东西没记住，而不是没预测好变化。据此提出 PersistWorld：把相机帧流式地**写入**一个锚定在场景坐标系里的持久 3D 世界状态，用 Evolver 按自车轨迹把状态**演化**到任意查询时刻，再用 Reader **读出**占用。在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，它比最强的相机方法 SparseWorld-TC 在 1–3 s 高 19 个 IoU 点、在 1–8 s 高 18–24 个点，速度还快一倍多（23.15 FPS）。
papers.summary_en: The authors first split the future scene into three types of space, "unchanged / changed / unseen", and find that camera-only occupancy world models lose mainly on the first type: they fail to remember things that have already been seen and have not changed, rather than failing to predict the changes. Based on this, they propose PersistWorld: camera frames are streamed and **written** into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene coordinate frame, an Evolver **evolves** the state to any query time according to the ego-vehicle trajectory, and a Reader **reads** out occupancy. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it is 19 IoU points higher than the strongest camera-based method, SparseWorld-TC, at 1-3 s and 18-24 points higher at 1-8 s, while also being more than twice as fast (23.15 FPS).

papers.title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
papers.summary: DexDuet 从**单条**人类双手演示出发，在仿真中用强化学习训练双灵巧手。它用三样东西：共享权重、能看到对方的"每只手一个策略"，对齐人手的两项交互奖励，以及按片段自适应的辅助课程 A-RSI。目标不只是让物体沿演示轨迹走，还要让机器人**握在人手握的部位、手指不在物体上打滑**。在 4 个基准、3 个仿真器、5 种机器人本体上，物体跟踪 ADD-AUC 比对应基线高 11–41 分，接触保持也全面领先。
papers.summary_en: Starting from a **single** human bimanual demonstration, DexDuet trains two dexterous robot hands with reinforcement learning in simulation. It uses three components: "one policy per hand" with shared weights that can observe the other hand, two interaction rewards aligned with the human hands, and A-RSI, a segment-wise adaptive auxiliary curriculum. The goal is not only to make the object follow the demonstrated trajectory, but also to have the robot **grasp where the human hand grasped, without the fingers slipping on the object**. Across 4 benchmarks, 3 simulators, and 5 robot embodiments, object-tracking ADD-AUC is 11-41 points higher than the corresponding baselines, and contact preservation leads across the board.

papers.title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
papers.summary: Innata-0将三塔世界-动作模型与负责规划、验证、恢复和技能进化的Agent用统一任务接口协同设计，复合与未见任务显著提升，但纯模型未登顶操作榜单，且缺真机实验。
papers.summary_en: Innata-0 co-designs a three-tower world-action model with an agent responsible for planning, verification, recovery, and skill evolution, connected through a unified task interface; it significantly improves on composite and unseen tasks, but the model alone does not top the manipulation leaderboards, and real-robot experiments are lacking.

papers.title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
papers.summary: **Motion Mamba 2.0 把 ARDY 式的"根轨迹—身体"两阶段自回归扩散去噪器，改成"局部注意力 + 可续接的 Mamba-3 递归状态 + 持久内容记忆（PCM）"的混合结构。历史状态只在一个干净窗口被接受后才提交。推理侧再用 CUDA Graph 和算子融合把单窗耗时压到 276 ms（比自己的 eager 实现快 6.1×）。结果是在 G1 人形机器人上，最长 39.5 s 的流式动作生成里终点空间约束误差最低，真机 100 次试验 94 次完整成功、0 次跌倒。**
papers.summary_en: **Motion Mamba 2.0 turns the ARDY-style two-stage "root trajectory, then body" autoregressive diffusion denoiser into a hybrid architecture of "local attention + resumable Mamba-3 recurrent state + Persistent Content Memory (PCM)". Historical state is committed only after a clean window has been accepted. On the inference side, CUDA Graphs and operator fusion bring the per-window latency down to 276 ms (6.1x faster than the authors' own eager implementation). As a result, on the G1 humanoid robot, it achieves the lowest endpoint spatial-constraint error in streaming motion generation of up to 39.5 s, and in 100 real-robot trials it achieves 94 complete successes and 0 falls.**

papers.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: 清华团队提出 nanoAstra，把 5,300 小时异构真机/UMI 示教整理成“进度描述 + 参数化动作原语（如 `move x +5.0`、`gripper open`）”组成的语义步骤，并用带机器人系统提示的能力保持微调（CP-SFT）与通用 VQA 数据联合训练，只用文本生成接口就让 Qwen3.5-9B 在 RoboTwin 2.0 随机化设置上零样本成功率达到 17.8%。这一结果超过了被测的 VLA、WAM 和更大的 VLM；在单张 H20 上推理比动作执行还快，因此可以流式执行。它是在复现 GPT-6 Astra 式“VLM 直接控机器人”能力上，一次公开、可复现的早期尝试。
papers.summary_en: A Tsinghua team proposes nanoAstra, which organizes 5,300 hours of heterogeneous real-robot/UMI demonstrations into semantic steps consisting of a "progress description + parameterized action primitives (e.g., `move x +5.0`, `gripper open`)", and trains jointly with capability-preserving fine-tuning (CP-SFT) using a robot system prompt together with general VQA data. Using only the text-generation interface, this enables Qwen3.5-9B to reach a 17.8% zero-shot success rate under the RoboTwin 2.0 randomized setting. This result exceeds the tested VLAs, WAMs, and larger VLMs; on a single H20, inference is faster than action execution, so it can execute in a streaming manner. It is an open, reproducible early attempt at replicating the GPT-6 Astra-style ability of a "VLM directly controlling a robot".

papers.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: **模型参数不动，只改"执行框架（harness）"**：Embodied-Harness 让一个冻结的 VLM 当 Actor，通过五种控制指令操纵机械臂；另一个 VLM 当 Reflector，根据执行轨迹找出失败原因，写成可复用的操作指导，并逐轮更新 harness。用 GPT-6 Astra 作骨干、不用任何示范，它在 RoboTwin 2.0 C2R、RoboSPA 和 RMBench 上分别达到 82.4%、76.7%、94.4% 的成功率，真实机器人上为 96.7%，超过需要全量示范训练的 VLA 和 WAM。
papers.summary_en: **The model parameters stay fixed; only the "execution framework (harness)" is changed**: Embodied-Harness has a frozen VLM act as the Actor, manipulating the robot arm through five control instructions; another VLM acts as the Reflector, identifying the causes of failure from execution trajectories, writing them up as reusable operational guidance, and updating the harness round by round. Using GPT-6 Astra as the backbone and no demonstrations at all, it achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, RoboSPA, and RMBench respectively, and 96.7% on a real robot, surpassing VLAs and WAMs that require training on full demonstrations.

papers.title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: **MomentMem 用一个经过训练的 VLM「记忆器」在线挑出包含关键视觉证据的少量原始图像帧，存进记忆栈，再交给 π0.5 执行器出动作；在作者新建的 VMBench（9 个需要记住"转瞬即逝的位置/外观/位置-外观对应关系"的任务）上，平均成功率达 49.9%，比最强基线高 31.7 个百分点。记忆器换外观后无需新标注仍然可用，学新任务只需 5 条记忆标注。**
papers.summary_en: **MomentMem uses a trained VLM "memorizer" to select online a small number of raw image frames containing key visual evidence, stores them in a memory stack, and then passes them to a π0.5 executor to produce actions; on VMBench, newly built by the authors (9 tasks that require remembering "fleeting positions/appearances/position-appearance correspondences"), it reaches an average success rate of 49.9%, 31.7 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. The memorizer remains usable after appearance changes without new annotations, and learning a new task requires only 5 memory annotations.**

papers.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
papers.summary: **Plan4D 把视频生成模型 LongCat-Video 和 3D 重建模型 Depth Anything 3 (DA3) 在 latent 层面"缝合"起来：给 DA3 加一个场景流头，再训练一个从 Wan VAE latent 直通 DA3 第 1 个 block 的线性 3D 卷积接口，然后把这个冻结的几何解码器当作可微分的"几何评审"，去约束视频扩散模型。这样，输入一张初始帧加一段动作文本，同一条生成 latent 就能同时解码出未来 RGB 视频、深度、相机射线、点云和场景流。动作视频本身不需要任何 4D 标注。**
papers.summary_en: **Plan4D "stitches" the video generation model LongCat-Video and the 3D reconstruction model Depth Anything 3 (DA3) together at the latent level: it adds a scene-flow head to DA3, trains a linear 3D convolutional interface that feeds Wan VAE latents directly into DA3's 1st block, and then uses this frozen geometry decoder as a differentiable "geometry critic" to constrain the video diffusion model. In this way, given an initial frame and an action text, a single generated latent can be decoded simultaneously into future RGB video, depth, camera rays, point clouds, and scene flow. The action videos themselves require no 4D annotations.**

papers.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
papers.summary: ViDecide 把视频推理看成"一串决策"而不是"一段定长视频"。它让视频扩散模型逐段因果地生成状态转移，并用视觉 EOS 帧自己决定何时停；训练噪声集中在决定"下一步做什么"的高噪声区；再用 Corrective Fine-tuning（CFT）把"导致失败的那份噪声"映射到模型自己重采样出的成功续写上。在游戏、规划和双臂机器人积木任务上，严格成功率从标准微调的 23.3% 提到 83.8%（此前最强方法为 67.8%）。
papers.summary_en: ViDecide treats video reasoning as "a sequence of decisions" rather than "a fixed-length video". It has the video diffusion model generate state transitions segment by segment in a causal manner, and uses a visual EOS frame to decide on its own when to stop; training noise is concentrated in the high-noise region that determines "what to do next"; it then uses Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT) to map "the noise that led to failure" onto successful continuations resampled by the model itself. On game, planning, and bimanual robot block tasks, the strict success rate rises from 23.3% with standard fine-tuning to 83.8% (the previous strongest method achieved 67.8%).

papers.title: UniVEP: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: flow-matching 机器人策略的网络到底该预测"速度"还是"干净动作终点"？作者系统比较后发现，高噪声阶段适合预测终点，低噪声阶段适合预测速度。于是提出 UniVEP：用同一个 DiT 联合训练两种预测，加一致性约束，采样时先走终点预测、后切到速度预测。每步仍只跑一次网络，在 RoboTwin 上 1 步推理就超过单目标基线 16 步的成绩，LiLa-WAM 2 步推理的延迟降低 77.1%。
papers.summary_en: Should the network of a flow-matching robot policy predict the "velocity" or the "clean action endpoint"? After a systematic comparison, the authors find that endpoint prediction suits the high-noise stage, while velocity prediction suits the low-noise stage. They therefore propose UniVEP: a single DiT is jointly trained on both predictions with a consistency constraint, and during sampling it first uses endpoint prediction and then switches to velocity prediction. Each step still runs the network only once; on RoboTwin, 1-step inference surpasses the 16-step results of single-objective baselines, and 2-step inference with LiLa-WAM reduces latency by 77.1%.

papers.title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
papers.summary: Fast-JEPA 的做法是：先用世界模型的中间预测一步步生成一条"目标导向"的初始动作计划，再在这条计划附近做轻量 CEM 搜索；每个完整候选只用一次"从当前观测直接预测终点"的查询来打分，不再递归推演中间状态。这样在 PushT、Reacher、Cube、TwoRoom 四个任务上，它以 10.88 ms 的规划延迟拿到 96.50% 的平均成功率，比 INTACT 快 2.41 倍。论文还提出了 DynaGoal 基准，用来测试动态目标、截止时间和响应延迟下的规划能力。
papers.summary_en: Fast-JEPA's approach is: first, use the world model's intermediate predictions to generate a "goal-directed" initial action plan step by step, and then run a lightweight CEM search in the neighborhood of this plan; each complete candidate is scored with just a single query that "predicts the endpoint directly from the current observation", no longer recursively rolling out intermediate states. As a result, on the four tasks PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, it achieves a 96.50% average success rate with a planning latency of 10.88 ms, 2.41x faster than INTACT. The paper also proposes the DynaGoal benchmark to test planning ability under dynamic goals, deadlines, and response latency.

papers.title: Non-penetrating World Models
papers.summary: 现有交互式视频世界模型被命令撞墙时，大多会直接"穿墙"。作者发现，冻结的 DiT 在画出下一段视频之前，其隐状态里就已经含有"这个动作会不会撞上"的信息。于是他们在 DiT 上接了一个参数不到 2M 的预测头，在生成前给 34 个候选运动打分，把危险指令换成最贴近用户意图的停止或贴墙滑行。不改生成器的任何权重，六个开源世界模型的平均穿模率就从 74% 降到了 16%，而且能零样本迁移到开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物。
papers.summary_en: When commanded to run into a wall, most existing interactive video world models simply "pass through the wall". The authors find that a frozen DiT, before it renders the next video segment, already contains in its hidden states information about "whether this action will cause a collision". They therefore attach a prediction head with fewer than 2M parameters to the DiT, which scores 34 candidate motions before generation and replaces dangerous commands with a stop or a wall-sliding motion that best matches the user's intent. Without modifying any of the generator's weights, the average penetration rate across six open-source world models drops from 74% to 16%, and the approach transfers zero-shot to open-domain images, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles.

papers.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
papers.summary: **StereoVLM 给 Qwen3-VL 输入标定好的左右目图像和相机参数（fx、基线 B），用“点对应 → 视差 → 度量深度 → 物体级 3D 定位”的分层问答数据做全参数微调，让 VLM 直接从双目几何中读出度量尺度。它在自建的 Stereo3D-Bench 上大幅领先通用 VLM 和单目深度 VLM（8B：深度 δ1 95.17%，物体级平均 66.98）。另一个关键发现是：在没见过的场景里，监督“视差”比直接监督“双目深度”泛化好得多（OOD δ1 74.92% 对 45.89%）。**
papers.summary_en: **StereoVLM feeds Qwen3-VL calibrated left and right stereo images together with camera parameters (fx, baseline B), and performs full-parameter fine-tuning on hierarchical question-answering data structured as "point correspondence -> disparity -> metric depth -> object-level 3D localization", enabling the VLM to read metric scale directly from binocular geometry. On the self-built Stereo3D-Bench, it substantially outperforms general-purpose VLMs and monocular-depth VLMs (8B: depth δ1 95.17%, object-level average 66.98). Another key finding is that in unseen scenes, supervising "disparity" generalizes much better than directly supervising "stereo depth" (OOD δ1 74.92% vs. 45.89%).**

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.summary: AgentRoboCritic让策略在每个动作旁自报局部意图，再由评判模型逐动作诊断成败与失败类型；分析12个操作基准发现，前沿agent能闭环纠错、零样本远超VLA，但短板在夹取定位与紧公差对位等毫米级物理执行。
papers.summary_en: AgentRoboCritic has the policy self-report its local intent alongside each action, and then a critic model diagnoses success or failure and the failure type action by action; an analysis of 12 manipulation benchmarks finds that frontier agents can perform closed-loop error correction and far outperform VLAs zero-shot, but their weaknesses lie in millimeter-level physical execution such as grasp localization and tight-tolerance alignment.

papers.title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.summary: **AeroRSI 让一个会失败的无人机 VLA 策略自己评判修复动作：在仿真器里回到失败前的状态，分别执行候选动作（策略自己采样的动作 + 简单规则提议），再由当前策略接着往下飞，只保留它能真正飞完的动作作为标签，然后蒸馏回策略。这个过程每轮重做一次，失败会随策略变化而转移，监督也跟着更新。在 TravelUAV 上，三轮把 2B 策略的成功率从 46.4% 提到 67.5%，碰撞率约减半，比此前 SOTA（AeroDPO）高 10.6 个点。全程不需要额外人工标注，推理开销也没有增加。**
papers.summary_en: **AeroRSI lets a failure-prone drone VLA policy judge repair actions by itself: in the simulator, it returns to the state before the failure, executes each candidate action (actions sampled by the policy itself + simple rule-based proposals), then has the current policy continue flying from there, keeping only the actions with which it can actually complete the flight as labels, and then distills them back into the policy. This process is redone every round, so failures shift as the policy changes and the supervision is updated accordingly. On TravelUAV, three rounds raise the 2B policy's success rate from 46.4% to 67.5%, roughly halve the collision rate, and exceed the previous SOTA (AeroDPO) by 10.6 points. The entire process requires no additional human annotation, and inference overhead does not increase.**

papers.title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
papers.summary: **这篇论文提出了 ReSpaceBench：在合成与真实家庭的漫游视频中受控地安排房间“重访”，并故意放入同类型的干扰房间，专门测试多模态大模型能否“认出回到的是哪一个具体房间”并据此维护空间记忆。测试结果是最强模型只有 50.5%（人类 90.1%）；现有视频智能体框架并不比直接推理好；而用作者配套的 RS-30K 数据微调 Qwen3-VL-8B，准确率能从 35.5% 提升到 60.4%。**
papers.summary_en: **This paper proposes ReSpaceBench: in walkthrough videos of synthetic and real homes, room "revisits" are arranged in a controlled manner, and distractor rooms of the same type are deliberately inserted, specifically to test whether multimodal large models can "recognize which specific room they have returned to" and maintain spatial memory accordingly. The results show that the strongest model achieves only 50.5% (humans 90.1%); existing video agent frameworks are no better than direct inference; and fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B with the authors' accompanying RS-30K data raises accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%.**

papers.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
papers.summary: **O²LaF 用同一个预训练视频 DiT（Wan2.2-5B）初始化逆动力学模型（IDM）和前向动力学模型（FDM），各自用 LoRA 适配：IDM 是带"只读"动作查询的单次前向编码器，FDM 是帧因果、整段联合预测、偏向高噪声训练的动作条件视频生成器。两者通过 32 维高斯瓶颈端到端训练，从无标注视频中学到隐动作。这些隐动作在导航和操作的少样本动作探测上达到新的 SOTA，并能零样本迁移到新场景，以及在人与机器人之间迁移。**
papers.summary_en: **O²LaF initializes both an inverse dynamics model (IDM) and a forward dynamics model (FDM) from the same pretrained video DiT (Wan2.2-5B), each adapted with LoRA: the IDM is a single-forward-pass encoder with "read-only" action queries, and the FDM is a frame-causal, action-conditioned video generator that jointly predicts the whole clip and is trained with a bias toward high noise. The two are trained end to end through a 32-dimensional Gaussian bottleneck to learn latent actions from unlabeled video. These latent actions achieve new SOTA in few-shot action probing for navigation and manipulation, and can transfer zero-shot to new scenes as well as between humans and robots.**

papers.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: **Mind2Act World 用 30 个双臂仿真操作任务，分成"只考记忆/推理（Mind）""只考精确与及时执行（Act）""两者闭环组合（Mind2Act）"三个视图，在 56,700 个回合上评测了 3 个多模态 Agent、4 个 VLA 和 2 个 WAM，并给每个失败回合归因。结论是：最强的 GPT-6 Astra 在 Mind 上成功 52.7%、Act 上 39.0%，到 Mind2Act 只剩 12.0%，端到端策略在 Mind2Act 上都不超过 3.6%。也就是说，单项能力不会自动组合起来；而且大部分组合任务在第一步物理操作就失败了，根本没走到真正需要组合的环节。**
papers.summary_en: **Mind2Act World uses 30 bimanual simulated manipulation tasks, divided into three views: "testing only memory/reasoning (Mind)," "testing only precise and timely execution (Act)," and "closed-loop composition of the two (Mind2Act)." It evaluates 3 multimodal agents, 4 VLAs, and 2 WAMs over 56,700 episodes, and attributes a cause to every failed episode. The conclusion: the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra, succeeds 52.7% of the time on Mind and 39.0% on Act, but only 12.0% on Mind2Act, and no end-to-end policy exceeds 3.6% on Mind2Act. In other words, individual capabilities do not automatically compose; moreover, most composition tasks fail at the very first physical manipulation step, never even reaching the stage that actually requires composition.**

papers.title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
papers.summary: ZeroVLN让VLM大脑以自然语言工具调用指挥动作专家，按大脑请求生成轨迹监督专家后联合强化学习，零导航微调即在三个VLN-CE基准取得同条件最高成功率，权重仅变0.015%，通用能力基本保留。
papers.summary_en: ZeroVLN has the VLM brain direct an action expert through natural-language tool calls. It supervises the expert with trajectories generated according to the brain's requests and then performs joint reinforcement learning. With zero navigation fine-tuning, it achieves the highest success rate under the same conditions on three VLN-CE benchmarks, while changing only 0.015% of the weights and largely preserving general capabilities.

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
papers.summary: 论文发现：把 VLA "遗忘"或"拒绝"某个禁止任务的现有方法，只在任务开头测试时显得有效，一旦在执行中途接管，机器人往往会照样把任务做完，或者半路把手里的东西扔掉。为此作者提出 SAFI：在禁止任务演示的**每一个中间状态**都把监督目标换成"原地保持、夹爪状态不变"，同时继续模仿保留任务的原始动作。在 OpenVLA-OFT + LIBERO 上，中途接管后的禁止任务完成率从 99.7% 降到 1.3%，没有记录到任何物理事故，保留任务性能基本不受影响。
papers.summary_en: The paper finds that existing methods for making a VLA "forget" or "refuse" a prohibited task only appear effective when tested at the start of the task; once control is taken over midway through execution, the robot often completes the task anyway, or drops the object it is holding partway through. To address this, the authors propose SAFI: at **every intermediate state** of the prohibited-task demonstrations, the supervision target is replaced with "hold in place, keep the gripper state unchanged," while the original actions of the retained tasks continue to be imitated. On OpenVLA-OFT + LIBERO, the prohibited-task completion rate after mid-execution takeover drops from 99.7% to 1.3%, no physical accidents were recorded, and retained-task performance is essentially unaffected.

papers.title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
papers.summary: 作者让 play 策略在执行时注入可记录的、时间相关的动作噪声，再加一个辅助损失 AFFECT：它要求世界模型生成视频里的特征随噪声变化的方式（即二者的协方差）与真实录像一致。这个方法不需要从同一初始状态重复执行，也不需要结果标签，就能让视频世界模型对细小动作差异更敏感。在 DROID 上，世界模型内与真机上策略成功率的 Pearson 相关从 0.47 升到 0.79，用于规划时成功率提高约 8 个百分点。
papers.summary_en: The authors have the play policy inject recordable, temporally correlated action noise during execution, and add an auxiliary loss, AFFECT, which requires that the way features in the world model's generated video vary with the noise (i.e., their covariance) match that of the real recordings. This method requires neither repeated executions from the same initial state nor outcome labels, yet it makes video world models more sensitive to small action differences. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates inside the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, and when used for planning, success rate improves by about 8 percentage points.

papers.title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: **PAD 把"一条驾驶演示数据值多少"定义成"它对某个具体规划器的下游驾驶得分有多大帮助"，具体做法是：先在独立的真实校准集上测出基础策略逐场景的 EPDMS，标准化成正负"优势"权重，再用随机投影梯度加阻尼协方差（TRAK 式影响函数）估计每条合成演示对这个"按得分加权的校准损失"的一阶影响，最后只保留得分前 B 条去重训。在 NAVSIM v2 上，DiffusionDrive 只用 25% 的 SimScale 合成数据，就比纯真实数据训练高 +3.5（NavTest）和 +5.0（NavHard）EPDMS，也比全量合成数据更好，场景级退化大约减少到原来的 1/3。**
papers.summary_en: **PAD defines "how much a driving demonstration is worth" as "how much it helps the downstream driving score of a specific planner." Concretely, it first measures the base policy's per-scenario EPDMS on an independent real calibration set and standardizes these into positive and negative "advantage" weights; it then uses random-projection gradients with a damped covariance (a TRAK-style influence function) to estimate each synthetic demonstration's first-order influence on this "score-weighted calibration loss"; finally, it keeps only the top-B scoring demonstrations for retraining after deduplication. On NAVSIM v2, DiffusionDrive using only 25% of the SimScale synthetic data outperforms training on real data alone by +3.5 (NavTest) and +5.0 (NavHard) EPDMS, also does better than using the full synthetic dataset, and reduces scenario-level degradations to roughly one third of the original.**

papers.title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
papers.summary: **Accord 在 DAVIO 的"VIO 位姿 + 位姿条件化 DA3 深度"框架上加了两层尺度修正：先用 VIO 三角化的稀疏点给每个关键帧窗口定一个度量锚，再利用不同窗口共视图像之间的双向稠密深度一致性，为每张图解出一个无监督的尺度校正，把单目稠密地图中几个百分点的尺度误差压下去。用同一套配置跑 5 个公开相机-IMU 平台和自采的手机/GoPro 数据，并在"整图只按系统自身轨迹放置、不拟合尺度"的严格协议下评测，它在四个有扫描真值的公开数据集上平均 F@5cm 都是第一。**
papers.summary_en: **Accord adds two layers of scale correction on top of DAVIO's "VIO poses + pose-conditioned DA3 depth" framework: first, it uses sparse points triangulated by VIO to set a metric anchor for each keyframe window; then, using bidirectional dense depth consistency between co-visible images across different windows, it solves for an unsupervised scale correction for each image, suppressing the scale errors of a few percent in the monocular dense map. Running a single configuration on 5 public camera-IMU platforms and self-collected phone/GoPro data, and evaluated under a strict protocol in which "the entire map is placed only according to the system's own trajectory, with no scale fitting," it ranks first in average F@5cm on all four public datasets with scanned ground truth.**

papers.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
papers.summary: 论文提出 SimAudit：用 LLM 智能体对照任务指令阅读成功判定代码，猜测可能判错的状态，在未修改的仿真器里把这些状态真实搭出来，再交给一个独立的 VLM 看多视角渲染图复核。用这套流程，作者在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365、RoboDojo 三个主流仿真基准里找到 61 个经视觉核实的判定器缺陷，其中 40 个"幻影成功"、21 个"无声失败"。修复后用同一批策略回放重新打分，最多有 9.1% 的回合判定翻转。
papers.summary_en: The paper proposes SimAudit: an LLM agent reads the success-checking code against the task instruction, hypothesizes states that might be misjudged, actually constructs those states in the unmodified simulator, and then hands them to an independent VLM to re-check using multi-view renderings. Using this pipeline, the authors found 61 visually verified checker defects across three mainstream simulation benchmarks, RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo, including 40 "phantom successes" and 21 "silent failures." After fixing them and re-scoring replays of the same set of policies, up to 9.1% of episodes had their outcomes flipped.

papers.title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
papers.summary: **Inhabitant 是一个免训练的 LLM 智能体框架：智能体不再只写文本或调技能，而是直接用位置、路径和姿态编写 Kimodo 运动生成器的约束（空间控制），在半物理模拟器里执行后按需测量手离物体多远、物体落在哪（量化反馈），再改约束重试，测量结果符合意图才提交这一段动作。作者在自建的 75 任务全身家务基准 Inhabit 上测试，用 Claude Opus 5.5 完成了 98.7% 的任务，同一模型驱动的最佳已有智能体只有 26.7%。**
papers.summary_en: **Inhabitant is a training-free LLM agent framework: instead of merely writing text or invoking skills, the agent directly authors constraints for the Kimodo motion generator using positions, paths, and poses (spatial control). After execution in a semi-physical simulator, it measures on demand how far the hand is from an object and where the object landed (quantitative feedback), then revises the constraints and retries, committing a motion segment only when the measurements match the intent. The authors test it on Inhabit, their self-built 75-task whole-body household benchmark; with Claude Opus 5.5 it completes 98.7% of the tasks, while the best existing agent driven by the same model achieves only 26.7%.**

papers.title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary: WAM-Policy 把一个为机械臂预训练的世界动作模型（LingBot-VA）改造成"三条腿走路、一条前腿干活"的四足机器人语言条件策略。做法分两步：先换掉视觉和动作接口，再用同噪声的在线自蒸馏把采样压到 1 步视频 + 2 步动作，提速 14 倍且几乎不掉点（77.0%→76.7%）；然后对难任务单独做 RL 训练出专家教师，再用按任务路由的多教师在线蒸馏把它们合并回一个快速学生，十任务成功率升到 85.0%。
papers.summary_en: WAM-Policy adapts a world action model pretrained for robotic arms (LingBot-VA) into a language-conditioned policy for a quadruped robot that "walks on three legs and works with one front leg." The approach has two steps. First, it replaces the visual and action interfaces, then uses same-noise on-policy self-distillation to compress sampling to 1 video step + 2 action steps, achieving a 14x speedup with almost no performance drop (77.0% -> 76.7%). Second, it trains expert teachers separately with RL on the hard tasks, then uses task-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation to merge them back into a single fast student, raising the ten-task success rate to 85.0%.

papers.title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: VSpark 保持**严格（无损）验证**不变，把“很多不同 token 编码近似相同动作”这一特点用在**草稿侧**：用按草稿误差标定的动作噪声做 rollout 来扩大训练状态覆盖，用目标模型的隐藏特征对齐来训练草稿，再把目标在被拒分支上已经算好的续写复用到下一轮草稿树里。结果是在 FAST 和 VQ 两类压缩动作分词器的 4 个自回归 VLA、4 个操作基准上，相对逐 token 自回归解码拿到 1.28×–2.10× 的加速，而且在所有模型和基准上都优于 5 种最新推测解码方法。
papers.summary_en: VSpark keeps **strict (lossless) verification** unchanged and exploits the property that "many different tokens encode approximately the same action" on the **draft side**: it performs rollouts with action noise calibrated to the draft error to expand training state coverage, trains the draft via alignment with the target model's hidden features, and reuses continuations the target has already computed on rejected branches in the next round's draft tree. As a result, across 4 autoregressive VLAs using two types of compressed action tokenizers (FAST and VQ) and 4 manipulation benchmarks, it achieves 1.28x-2.10x speedups over token-by-token autoregressive decoding, and outperforms 5 recent speculative decoding methods on all models and benchmarks.

papers.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
papers.summary: HINT-WAM 让世界动作模型自己当老师：老师比学生多看到示范视频里的“未来帧”（hindsight）。学生沿着自己的去噪采样轨迹生成动作，再用能量分数（energy score）在分布层面向这位老师对齐。全程不需要奖励、仿真器，也不需要额外的教师模型。最终 LIBERO-90 成功率从 SFT 的 78.9% 提升到 85.2%，遗忘也更少。
papers.summary_en: HINT-WAM makes the world action model serve as its own teacher: the teacher sees more than the student, namely the "future frames" (hindsight) in the demonstration video. The student generates actions along its own denoising sampling trajectory and is then aligned with this teacher at the distribution level using an energy score. The whole process requires no rewards, no simulator, and no additional teacher model. In the end, the LIBERO-90 success rate rises from 78.9% with SFT to 85.2%, with less forgetting as well.

papers.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
papers.summary: **BiCAT 是给自回归 VLA 用的双臂动作 tokenizer。它先把右臂镜像到左臂的坐标约定，让两臂共用一个编码器和一套码表；再在量化前用对称的因果跨臂注意力、在量化后用联合解码器交换另一只手臂的信息。策略端分两块预测，先并行出左臂的 8 个 token，再以左臂为条件并行出右臂的 8 个 token。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，它的平均成功率比最强基线 NAC 高 17.6 个百分点（69.3% vs 51.7%），每个动作块只要 40.5 ms；在三种真实双臂机器人上成功 113/150 次，OAT 为 74/150，FAST 为 25/150。**
papers.summary_en: **BiCAT is a bimanual action tokenizer for autoregressive VLAs. It first mirrors the right arm into the left arm's coordinate convention so that both arms share one encoder and one codebook; it then exchanges information from the other arm using symmetric causal cross-arm attention before quantization and a joint decoder after quantization. On the policy side, prediction is split into two blocks: first the left arm's 8 tokens are produced in parallel, then the right arm's 8 tokens are produced in parallel conditioned on the left arm. On RoboTwin 2.0, its average success rate is 17.6 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline NAC (69.3% vs 51.7%), and each action chunk takes only 40.5 ms; on three real bimanual robots it succeeded 113/150 times, compared with 74/150 for OAT and 25/150 for FAST.**

papers.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: TCP4D 用同一个前馈 4D 场景表征，从单目 RGB 视频里直接回归末端工具中心点（TCP）的度量级 SE(3) 位姿和夹爪开合（Tracker），再沿这些轨迹采特征，用 DiT 生成未来 TCP 轨迹作为策略（Generator）。顺带得到一条不需要源机器人状态记录的跨本体数据增广管线：视频 → TCP 轨迹 → 目标机器人 IK → 抹掉原机器人、渲染新机器人。
papers.summary_en: TCP4D uses a single feed-forward 4D scene representation to directly regress, from monocular RGB video, the metric-scale SE(3) pose of the end-effector tool center point (TCP) and the gripper opening/closing (Tracker), then samples features along these trajectories and uses a DiT to generate future TCP trajectories as a policy (Generator). As a by-product, it yields a cross-embodiment data augmentation pipeline that does not require state recordings from the source robot: video → TCP trajectory → target-robot IK → erase the original robot and render the new robot.

papers.title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.summary: Heave-Ho 用两层结构让多台人形机器人在**机器人之间完全不走网络通信**的条件下合作搬运重物：底层在冻结的人形基础跟踪模型 SONIC 之上加一个多机器人共享的残差策略，用 MAPPO 后训练；高层由 leader 机器人上微调过的 Qwen3-VL-2B 每次选出一个离散"团队技能"并**说出来**，follower 用麦克风识别后，大家在同一个粗时间网格上一起开始执行。只用两台 G1 训练出来的策略，能直接部署到 4–10 台机器人、异构机器人和有人参与的团队。真实世界 100 次试验成功 92 次，仿真里底层成功率 94.4%，而所有基线和消融都不超过 28.6%。
papers.summary_en: Heave-Ho uses a two-level structure to let multiple humanoid robots cooperatively carry heavy objects under the condition of **no network communication at all between robots**: the low level adds a residual policy shared across robots on top of the frozen humanoid foundation tracking model SONIC, post-trained with MAPPO; at the high level, a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B on the leader robot selects one discrete "team skill" at a time and **speaks it aloud**, the followers recognize it via microphone, and everyone starts executing together on the same coarse time grid. The policy, trained with only two G1 robots, can be deployed directly to teams of 4–10 robots, heterogeneous robots, and teams with human participants. In the real world it succeeded in 92 of 100 trials; in simulation the low-level success rate is 94.4%, while all baselines and ablations reach no more than 28.6%.

papers.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
papers.summary: **Hub Labs 让 12,227 名真实从业者用头戴手机，在自己的车间、工地和家里录下没有脚本的技能劳动，得到 10,124 小时 1080p 第一人称视频，每帧都对齐了 IMU，同时附带机器生成的动作和语言标注，以 CC BY 4.0 开放。论文的核心卖点是"按多个轴测量出来的多样性"：人数和环境数都比已有的第一人称数据集高一个数量级。但这一版只给了统计分析，没有任何模型训练实验来证明这些数据真的能提升机器人策略。**
papers.summary_en: **Hub Labs had 12,227 real practitioners use head-mounted phones to record unscripted skilled labor in their own workshops, construction sites, and homes, producing 10,124 hours of 1080p first-person video with IMU aligned to every frame, along with machine-generated action and language annotations, released openly under CC BY 4.0. The paper's core selling point is "diversity measured along multiple axes": both the number of people and the number of environments are an order of magnitude higher than in existing first-person datasets. However, this version provides only statistical analysis, with no model training experiments to demonstrate that the data actually improves robot policies.**

papers.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
papers.summary: ForceHarness 在只能通过 API 调用、权重冻结的前沿多模态模型和机械臂之间加了三层"外壳"：力校准、自终止力原语、物理量翻译。快速的力闭环交给模型底下的原语去做，模型只读到带不确定度的物理量（质量、接触高度、摩擦系数、插入深度等）。结果是不需要任何示教或微调，前沿模型就能完成必须靠力才能做成的操作：真机零样本成功率从 3.3% 升到 90%；在 HiddenPhys 上与手写专家控制器持平，并明显超过用约 200 条示教训练的力感知策略。
papers.summary_en: ForceHarness adds three layers of "harness" between a frontier multimodal model that is accessible only through API calls with frozen weights and a robotic arm: force calibration, self-terminating force primitives, and physical-quantity translation. The fast force closed loop is handed off to primitives beneath the model, and the model only reads physical quantities with uncertainty estimates (mass, contact height, friction coefficient, insertion depth, etc.). The result is that, without any demonstrations or fine-tuning, frontier models can complete manipulation tasks that can only be accomplished through force: the real-robot zero-shot success rate rises from 3.3% to 90%; on HiddenPhys it matches hand-written expert controllers and clearly outperforms a force-aware policy trained on about 200 demonstrations.

papers.title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
papers.summary: PanDWM 把 nuScenes 六个环视相机拼成一条 360°×33.3° 的全景带，再用一个 4 步、块因果、在自己生成的历史上训练的扩散学生模型逐窗口预测未来全景视频。在 Val-150 的全景空间评测中，它的 FID 和 FVD 低于所有多相机基线，速度快 8–46 倍。之后，一个前馈解码器沿各像素原始相机的标定射线，把生成帧提升为 3D/4D 高斯场景，用于新视角渲染。
papers.summary_en: PanDWM stitches the six surround-view cameras of nuScenes into a single 360°×33.3° panoramic strip, then uses a 4-step, block-causal diffusion student model trained on its own generated history to predict future panoramic video window by window. In panoramic-space evaluation on Val-150, its FID and FVD are lower than all multi-camera baselines, and it is 8–46 times faster. Afterwards, a feed-forward decoder lifts the generated frames into 3D/4D Gaussian scenes along the calibrated rays of each pixel's original camera, for novel-view rendering.

papers.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.summary: ResWAM 不再让世界-动作模型预测“未来画面长什么样”，而是只预测冻结 DINOv3 特征空间里“从现在到未来变了多少”（Δ = Z_{t+H} − Z_t）。它用一个 0.5B 的双分支 DiT，通过流匹配同时生成动作和这个视觉残差，总参数 2.3B，不做机器人预训练。在 LIBERO-Plus（81.1%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.8%）、RoboDojo（9.40%）和真机（80.0%）上，它的平均成功率都是最高的，训练/推理算力和延迟（约 92–100 ms）也都是最低的。
papers.summary_en: ResWAM no longer has the world-action model predict "what the future frame looks like"; instead, it only predicts "how much changes from now to the future" in the frozen DINOv3 feature space (Δ = Z_{t+H} − Z_t). It uses a 0.5B dual-branch DiT to jointly generate actions and this visual residual via flow matching, with 2.3B total parameters and no robot pretraining. On LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), RoboDojo (9.40%), and real robots (80.0%), its average success rate is the highest, and its training/inference compute and latency (about 92–100 ms) are also the lowest.

papers.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
papers.summary: **ScaleVLA 把冻结的 552B MoE 前沿 VLM（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）只跑前半段因果编码器取特征，接一个从零训练的 GR00T 式 flow-matching 动作 DiT。在动作头、数据和训练预算都固定的对照下，backbone 从 2B 扩到 552B 后，样本效率（10 条示教超过 2B 用 50 条）、分布外泛化（LIBERO-PRO 45.1% 对最多 31.3%）和真机精细插接（9/10 对 4/10）都有提升，每个动作块的中位延迟仍只有 216 ms。说明前沿 VLM 不只能当“推理代理”，也能当学习型机器人策略的表征底座。**
papers.summary_en: **ScaleVLA runs only the first half (the causal encoder) of a frozen 552B MoE frontier VLM (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) to extract features, and attaches a GR00T-style flow-matching action DiT trained from scratch. In a controlled comparison with the action head, data, and training budget all held fixed, scaling the backbone from 2B to 552B improves sample efficiency (10 demonstrations outperform the 2B model with 50), out-of-distribution generalization (45.1% vs. at most 31.3% on LIBERO-PRO), and fine-grained real-robot insertion (9/10 vs. 4/10), while the median latency per action chunk remains only 216 ms. This shows that frontier VLMs can serve not only as "reasoning agents" but also as the representational foundation for learned robot policies.**

papers.title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
papers.summary: **SALA 只用人类和机器人视频各自的原子动作语言描述（例如"grasp the cup"），不需要成对数据，就把人类视频的潜在动作软性地对齐到"用真实机器人动作锚定过"的机器人潜在动作上。这样一来，无动作标签的人类视频也能直接监督控制机器人的同一个 VLA 策略。两种用法都随人类视频增多而提升：预训练用的通用人类视频从 0 增加到 2,678 小时，机器人动作预测误差持续下降；后训练用的任务人类演示增多，真机成功率从 53.75% 升到 72.5%。**
papers.summary_en: **Using only atomic-action language descriptions of human and robot videos separately (e.g., "grasp the cup"), and without requiring paired data, SALA softly aligns the latent actions of human videos to robot latent actions that have been "anchored with real robot actions." As a result, human videos without action labels can also directly supervise the same VLA policy that controls the robot. Both usages improve as more human video is added: when the general human video used for pretraining increases from 0 to 2,678 hours, robot action prediction error decreases steadily; as more task-specific human demonstrations are used in post-training, the real-robot success rate rises from 53.75% to 72.5%.**

papers.title: Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos
papers.summary: 在 VLA 的 VLM 主干旁并联一个"预测未来帧视觉特征"的生成专家（SPAR）。这样一来，没有动作标注的人类第一视角视频也能参与训练：它们只负责塑造共享主干的表征，推理时把生成专家拆掉。这种做法让策略在分布外（OOD）场景下的成功率随视频时长稳定上升，但提升幅度目前只有 1 个点左右。
papers.summary_en: A generative expert (SPAR) that "predicts the visual features of future frames" is attached in parallel alongside the VLM backbone of a VLA. This way, human egocentric videos without action annotations can also take part in training: they serve only to shape the representations of the shared backbone, and the generative expert is removed at inference time. This approach makes the policy's success rate in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios rise steadily with video duration, but the improvement is currently only around 1 point.

papers.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
papers.summary: **Gamer 只看屏幕像素、只输出原生键鼠操作。它用一套"跨游戏键鼠轨迹继续预训练 → 带稀疏思考与记忆摘要的多层级指令微调 → 按记忆分段的时序感知 GRPO 在线强化学习"的三阶段流程，加上自研的低延迟推理引擎 Streaming-vLLM（单步延迟从 1.31 s 降到 65 ms），把 Qwen3-VL-8B 训练成能在《崩坏：星穹铁道》里实时完成长时程任务的智能体：两个留出的支线任务里程碑准确率达到 80.0% 和 83.6%，7 类小游戏宏平均 49.7%，均明显高于各通用大模型基线。**
papers.summary_en: **Gamer looks only at screen pixels and outputs only native keyboard and mouse actions. It uses a three-stage pipeline of "continued pretraining on cross-game keyboard-and-mouse trajectories -> multi-level instruction fine-tuning with sparse thinking and memory summaries -> temporally aware GRPO online reinforcement learning segmented by memory", together with an in-house low-latency inference engine, Streaming-vLLM (which cuts per-step latency from 1.31 s to 65 ms), to train Qwen3-VL-8B into an agent that can complete long-horizon tasks in real time in Honkai: Star Rail: it reaches milestone accuracies of 80.0% and 83.6% on two held-out side quests and a macro average of 49.7% across 7 categories of mini-games, all clearly higher than the various general-purpose large model baselines.**

papers.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
